name: UA3P Series
tagline: Nanometre-level form measurement for precision optics and parts

intro.text: The Panasonic UA3P measures aspherical lenses and their moulds, free-form mirrors, semiconductor wafers and other precision parts that need nanometre-level accuracy. It combines an atomic force probe with HeNe laser interferometer positioning on X, Y and Z, and a granite base lets it work on the factory floor with total uncertainty at the 0.1 µm level.

items: Automatic NC program generation for fast feedback to machining
Wide library of optional analysis software
